queries:
WITH figures AS (
    SELECT 'total bytes / total milliseconds' AS interpretation,
           m.Name AS media_type,
           1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

SELECT MediaTypeId,
       1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
GROUP BY MediaTypeId

SELECT MediaTypeId,
       SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY MediaTypeId

SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY MediaTypeId

SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(Bytes) / AVG(Milliseconds) AS figure
FROM Track
GROUP BY MediaTypeId

SELECT AVG(track_count)
FROM (
    SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
    FROM MediaType AS mt
    LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY mt.Name
)
